Store long-term memory of design patterns and bug fixes to reduce architectural regressions. Set up a high-performance, multi-threaded key-value store compatible with Redis protocols for real-time collaboration and session management, handling synchronization of editor deltas via WebSockets with sub-millisecond latency and conflict-free replicated data types for editing conflicts. Enable Cypher queries for detecting circular dependencies and calculating critical paths for changes. Configure a time-series database for high-velocity telemetry and event logging, partitioned by project ID and clustered by timestamp for efficient range queries, using monotonic timestamps for consistent event ordering across microservices.

Create a bi-directional visual editor using abstract syntax tree manipulation, injecting data-source-loc attributes into UI elements during builds, parsing and traversing the AST to apply transformations from visual interactions directly to the source code.

Enable automated containerization by building production images from verified sandbox states and pushing them to a cloud artifact registry, managing regional repositories, service accounts, and IAM roles. Deploy to a serverless container platform with automated configuration of service definitions, revision history, zero-downtime deployments, and instant rollbacks, allowing transition from idea to production with a single command.

Define an app instance with a custom image installing required packages and running browser automation setup commands. Create an infrastructure state class initializing connections to the vector index, document collection, graph driver, key-value store, and time-series session using environment variables for credentials and endpoints. Define an agentic orchestrator class initializing AI clients with API keys from environment variables, with methods for running the planning mode (creating plans via the reasoning model and upserting to the document database), fast code generation, and visual healing (generating content from video bytes using the multimodal model). Register sidecar tools for filesystem operations. Define a web endpoint function for processing commands asynchronously, handling plan, generate, verify, and deploy types, with error handling for invalid types. Implement an asynchronous deployment function building and pushing container images, then deploying to the serverless platform using subprocess commands. Add a function to create sandboxes with custom images, commands for package installation, and timeouts.
Step 8: Implement the frontend in a single HTML file named index.html. Write the complete frontend code for the interactive workspace, integrating a code editor, terminal emulator, and agentic insight panel. Include HTML structure with metadata, stylesheet links for styling and terminal, script sources for terminal library, editor loader, and body layout using flexible containers for navigation, sidebar, editor, terminal, and insight sections. Style with dark theme classes for backgrounds, borders, text, and interactive elements. Initialize a terminal instance with custom theme, font, and transparency, opening it in the terminal container. Configure and create a code editor instance with initial JavaScript value, dark theme, automatic layout, font size, line numbers, and hidden scrollbars/minimap. Establish a WebSocket connection to the shim endpoint, handling messages to write to the terminal or update editor content. Add event listeners for agent input submission (appending to insight feed, posting to process_command endpoint for planning, and displaying responses), and deploy button clicks (writing to terminal, posting to deploy endpoint, and displaying success URLs).
Step 9: Finalize the system with conclusion and forward-looking integration. Ensure all components converge to enable fully autonomous software engineering, decoupling compute from local hardware, optimizing AI for coding tasks, providing persistence for project management, and guaranteeing consistent, secure builds. Verify the system allows shifting from code writing to defining high-level goals and oversight, with efficiency in planning, building, testing, and deploying. Output the complete server.py and index.html files as the final deliverables, along with any necessary configuration files or environment setup instructions for production deployment.

class InfraState:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.redis = None
        self.mongo = None
        self.mongo_db = None
        self.neo4j = None
        self.qdrant = None
        self.influx = None
        self.influx_write = None
        self.influx_bucket = os.environ.get("INFLUX_BUCKET", "")
        self.influx_org = os.environ.get("INFLUX_ORG", "")

        await self._init_secrets()
        await self._init_redis()
        await self._init_mongo()
        await self._init_neo4j()
        await self._init_qdrant()
        await self._init_influx()

    async def close(self) -> None:
        if self.redis is not None:
            try:
                await self.redis.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        if self.mongo is not None:
            try:
                self.mongo.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        if self.neo4j is not None:
            try:
                await self.neo4j.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        if self.influx is not None:
            try:
                await self.influx.__aexit__(None, None, None)
            except Exception:
                pass

        uri = os.environ.get("NEO4J_URI", "").strip()
        user = os.environ.get("NEO4J_USER", "").strip()
        pwd = os.environ.get("NEO4J_PASSWORD", "").strip()
        if uri and user and pwd and AsyncGraphDatabase is not None:
            self.neo4j = AsyncGraphDatabase.driver(uri, auth=(user, pwd))

    async def _init_qdrant(self) -> None:

        api_key = os.environ.get("QDRANT_API_KEY", "").strip()
        if url and AsyncQdrantClient is not None:
            self.qdrant = AsyncQdrantClient(url=url, api_key=api_key or None)

            try:

                    vectors_config=VectorParams(size=dim, distance=Distance.COSINE),

        url = os.environ.get("INFLUX_URL", "").strip()
        token = os.environ.get("INFLUX_TOKEN", "").strip()
        org = self.influx_org
        if url and token and org and InfluxDBClientAsync is not None:

    return signer.sign(user.encode()).decode()

    try:
        user = signer.unsign(token.encode()).decode()
        return AuthSession(user=user)
    except BadSignature:
        return None

async def get_session(request: Request) -> AuthSession:
    token = request.cookies.get(SESSION_COOKIE)
    if not token:
        raise HTTPException(401, "unauthorized")
    session = verify_session(token)
    if not session:
        raise HTTPException(401, "unauthorized")
    return session

    csrf = request.headers.get(CSRF_HEADER)
    token = request.cookies.get("csrf")
    if not csrf or not token or csrf != token:
        raise HTTPException(403, "csrf")

async def secure_path(rel: str) -> Path:
    rel = rel.lstrip("/").strip()
    target = (WORKSPACE / rel).resolve()
    if not str(target).startswith(str(WORKSPACE)):
        raise HTTPException(400, "invalid_path")
    return target

    lp = str(path) + ".lock"

        locks[lp] = FileLock(lp)
    return locks[lp]

def tree(path: Path) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    items: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for p in sorted(path.iterdir(), key=lambda x: (not x.is_dir(), x.name.lower())):
        item: Dict[str, Any] = {"name": p.name, "path": str(p.relative_to(WORKSPACE)), "type": "dir" if p.is_dir() else "file"}
        if p.is_dir():
            try:
                item["children"] = tree(p)
            except Exception:
                item["children"] = []
        items.append(item)
    return items

    model = os.environ.get("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini").strip()
    if not key:
        raise HTTPException(500, "missing_openai_api_key")
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {"model": model, "messages": messages, "stream": True}
    if tools:
        payload["tools"] = tools
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=None) as client:
        async with client.stream("POST", "", headers=headers, json=payload) as r:
            async for line in r.aiter_lines():
                if not line:
                    continue
                if line.startswith("data: "):
                    data = line[6:]
                    if data == "[DONE]":
                        break
                    obj = json.loads(data)
                    choice = obj["choices"][0]
                    delta = choice.get("delta", {})
                    content = delta.get("content")
                    if content:
                        yield content

def detect_dependencies() -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
    edges: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
    py_import = re.compile(r"^\s*(from\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_\.]+)\s+import\s+|import\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_\.]+))", re.M)
    js_import = re.compile(r"^\s*(import\s+.*?\s+from\s+['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]|require\(\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]\s*\))", re.M)
    files = [p for p in WORKSPACE.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size <= MAX_FILE_BYTES]
    for f in files:
        rel = str(f.relative_to(WORKSPACE))
        try:
            text = f.read_text(errors="ignore")
        except Exception:
            continue
        if f.suffix == ".py":
            for m in py_import.finditer(text):
                mod = m.group(2) or m.group(3) or ""
                if not mod:
                    continue
                edges.append((rel, mod))
        elif f.suffix in (".js", ".ts", ".jsx", ".tsx"):
            for m in js_import.finditer(text):
                mod = m.group(2) or m.group(3) or ""
                if not mod:
                    continue
                edges.append((rel, mod))
    return edges

async def cloud_run_deploy(cmd: DeployCommand) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    project = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT", "").strip()
    if not project:
        raise HTTPException(500, "missing_GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
    if not cmd.region:
        raise HTTPException(400, "missing_region")
    if not cmd.artifact_repo:
        raise HTTPException(400, "missing_artifact_repo")
    if not cmd.service:
        raise HTTPException(400, "missing_service")
    image = f"{cmd.region}-docker.pkg.dev/{project}/{cmd.artifact_repo}/{cmd.image_name}:{cmd.tag}"
    await telemetry(cmd.project_id, "deploy_start", {"image": image, "service": cmd.service, "region": cmd.region})
    docker_cfg_cmd = ["gcloud", "auth", "configure-docker", f"{cmd.region}-docker.pkg.dev", "--quiet"]
    build_cmd = ["docker", "build", "-t", image, str(WORKSPACE)]
    push_cmd = ["docker", "push", image]
    deploy_cmd = ["gcloud", "run", "deploy", cmd.service, "--image", image, "--region", cmd.region, "--project", project, "--platform", "managed", "--quiet"]
    if cmd.allow_unauthenticated:
        deploy_cmd += ["--allow-unauthenticated"]
    if cmd.memory:
        deploy_cmd += ["--memory", cmd.memory]
    if cmd.cpu:
        deploy_cmd += ["--cpu", cmd.cpu]
    if cmd.max_instances is not None:
        deploy_cmd += ["--max-instances", str(cmd.max_instances)]
    for k, v in (cmd.env or {}).items():
        deploy_cmd += ["--set-env-vars", f"{k}={v}"]
    def run_sync(args: List[str]) -> Tuple[int, str]:
        p = subprocess.run(args, cwd=str(WORKSPACE), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
        return p.returncode, p.stdout
    for step, args in [("auth_docker", docker_cfg_cmd), ("docker_build", build_cmd), ("docker_push", push_cmd), ("cloudrun_deploy", deploy_cmd)]:
        rc, out = await asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, run_sync, args)
        await telemetry(cmd.project_id, "deploy_step", {"step": step, "rc": rc, "output": out[-4000:]})
        if rc != 0:
            await telemetry(cmd.project_id, "deploy_failed", {"step": step})
            raise HTTPException(500, f"deploy_failed_{step}")
    url = ""
    try:
        rc, out = await asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(
            None,
            run_sync,
            ["gcloud", "run", "services", "describe", cmd.service, "--region", cmd.region, "--project", project, "--format", "value(status.url)"],
        )
        if rc == 0:
            url = out.strip()
    except Exception:
        url = ""
    await telemetry(cmd.project_id, "deploy_done", {"url": url})
    return {"ok": True, "image": image, "url": url}

async def pty_reader_task(ws: WebSocket, fd: int, term_id: str):
    sel = selectors.DefaultSelector()
    sel.register(fd, selectors.EVENT_READ)
    try:
        while True:
            events = await asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, sel.select, 0.1)
            for key, _ in events:
                try:
                    data = os.read(key.fileobj, 4096)
                except OSError:
                    data = b""
                if not data:
                    await ws.send_bytes(b"")
                    return
                await ws.send_bytes(data)
    finally:
        try:
            sel.unregister(fd)
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            sel.close()
        except Exception:
            pass

async def pty_writer_task(ws: WebSocket, fd: int):
    while True:
        data = await ws.receive_bytes()
        if not data:
            return
        try:
            os.write(fd, data)
        except OSError:
            return

@app.websocket("/ws/terminal")
async def ws_terminal(ws: WebSocket):
    await ws.accept()
    rate_limit(ws.client.host + ":term", limit=200, window=60)
    term_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    pid, fd = pty.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.execvp(TERMINAL_SHELL, [TERMINAL_SHELL, *TERMINAL_ARGS])
    pty_processes[term_id] = {"pid": pid, "fd": fd}
    reader = asyncio.create_task(pty_reader_task(ws, fd, term_id))
    writer = asyncio.create_task(pty_writer_task(ws, fd))
    try:
        done, pending = await asyncio.wait({reader, writer}, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
        for t in pending:
            t.cancel()
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        pass
    finally:
        try:
            os.close(fd)
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        except Exception:
            pass
        pty_processes.pop(term_id, None)

async def stream_logs():
    global log_process
    if not log_process or not log_process.stdout:
        return
    proc = log_process
    while True:
        line = await asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, proc.stdout.readline)
        if not line:
            break
        log_append(line)
        for client in list(log_clients):
            try:
                await client.send_text(line)
            except Exception:
                try:
                    log_clients.discard(client)
                except Exception:
                    pass
    try:
        rc = proc.poll()
    except Exception:
        rc = None
    log_process = None
    await telemetry("default", "run_exit", {"rc": rc})

        typ = op.get("type")

            if not target.exists() or target.is_dir():
                results.append(None)
            else:
                if target.stat().st_size > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
                    results.append(None)
                else:
                    results.append(target.read_text(errors="ignore"))
        elif typ == "write":
            target = await secure_path(op.get("path", ""))
            content = str(op.get("content", ""))
            if len(content.encode()) > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
                results.append(False)
            else:
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with file_lock(target):
                    target.write_text(content)
                results.append(True)

            results.append(None)

function connectCollab(docId){
  state.collabDocId = "file:" + docId
  if(!window.Y){
    addCard("CRDT", "Yjs nem elérhető", "collab")
    return
  }
  if(state.collabWS){ try{ state.collabWS.close() }catch(e){} }
  state.ydoc = new Y.Doc()
  state.ytext = state.ydoc.getText("monaco")

  state.ytext.observe(()=>{
    if(state.applyingRemote) return
    const val = state.ytext.toString()
    if(state.model && val !== state.model.getValue()){
      state.applyingRemote = true
      const pos = state.editor ? state.editor.getPosition() : null
      state.model.setValue(val)
      if(pos && state.editor) state.editor.setPosition(pos)
      state.lastLocalValue = val
      state.applyingRemote = false
    }
  })

  state.ydoc.on("update", (update)=>{
    if(!state.collabWS || state.collabWS.readyState !== 1) return
    const b64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, Array.from(update)))
    state.collabWS.send(JSON.stringify({t:"u", u:b64}))
  })

  const ws = new WebSocket((location.protocol === "https:" ? "wss://" : "ws://") + location.host + "/ws/collab/" + encodeURIComponent(state.collabDocId))
  ws.onopen = ()=>{
    addCard("Collab", "Kapcsolódva: " + state.collabDocId, "crdt")
  }
  ws.onmessage = (ev)=>{
    let obj = null
    try{ obj = JSON.parse(ev.data) }catch(e){ return }
    if(obj.t === "sync" || obj.t === "u"){
      const bin = Uint8Array.from(atob(obj.u), c=>c.charCodeAt(0))
      Y.applyUpdate(state.ydoc, bin)
      if(obj.t === "sync"){
        const val = state.ytext.toString()
        if(state.model && val && val !== state.model.getValue()){
          state.applyingRemote = true
          state.model.setValue(val)
          state.lastLocalValue = val
          state.applyingRemote = false
        }
      }
    }
  }
  ws.onclose = ()=>{
    addCard("Collab", "Kapcsolat bontva", "crdt")
  }
  state.collabWS = ws
}

async function agentSend(){
  const text = $("agentText").value.trim()
  if(!text) return
  $("agentText").value = ""
  addCard("You", text, "input")
  if(state.agentMode === "plan"){
    const r = await api("/api/process_command", {method:"POST", headers:Object.assign({"Content-Type":"application/json"}, csrfHeader()), body:JSON.stringify({type:"plan", project_id:"default", payload:{prompt:text}})})
    addCard("Plan", JSON.stringify(r.plan, null, 2), "plan")
    return
  }
  if(state.agentMode === "generate"){
    const res = await fetch("/api/process_command", {method:"POST", headers:Object.assign({"Content-Type":"application/json"}, csrfHeader()), body:JSON.stringify({type:"generate", project_id:"default", payload:{prompt:text}})})
    if(!res.ok){
      addCard("Generate error", await res.text(), "err")
      return
    }
    const reader = res.body.getReader()
    const dec = new TextDecoder()
    let out = ""
    while(true){
      const {value, done} = await reader.read()
      if(done) break
      out += dec.decode(value, {stream:true})
      if(out.length > 20000) out = out.slice(-20000)
    }
    addCard("Generate", out, "code")
    return
  }
  if(state.agentMode === "store"){
    const mem = {id: crypto.randomUUID(), type:"note", path: state.activePath || "", text}
    const r = await api("/api/memory/upsert", {method:"POST", headers:Object.assign({"Content-Type":"application/json"}, csrfHeader()), body:JSON.stringify({type:"memory_upsert", project_id:"default", payload:{items:[mem]}})})
    addCard("Memory", JSON.stringify(r, null, 2), "vec")
    return
  }
}
